αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly (of an uncanny likeness); adv. · also general intensifier with a verb of emotion: αἰνῶς ἵεται ’is terribly eager’
αἰπὺν: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; masc. acc. sg.
αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg.
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βαθείης: βαθύς — deep; fem. gen. sg., epic -είης (= Attic -είας)
βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
βουλή: βουλή — plan, counsel, will; nom. sg.
βυσσοδομεύων: βυσσοδομεύω — plan deep in the heart, brood on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γαίης: γαῖα — earth, land; gen. sg. (Ionic η for α)
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλυκὺς: γλυκύς — sweet; masc. nom. sg. (γλυκὺς αἰών ’sweet life’)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’
δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, supper; neut. acc. sg. (περὶ δεῖπνον ’about the meal’)
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’)
διὶ: Ζεύς — Zeus, chief of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg. (purpose): ’might give’
δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὸς: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. imper. 2 sg.
δῖαν: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. acc. sg. δῖαν, here extended to the sea (ἅλα δῖαν ’the heavenly brine’) rather than a hero · also of a place-name: Λακεδαίμονα δῖαν ’heavenly Lacedaemon’ · also of Dawn: Ἠῶ δῖαν ’heavenly Dawn’
δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), used as nom./acc. sg.
εἰδότα: οἶδα — know, know how to; perf. part. masc. acc. sg. (with εὖ: ’well versed in’), + acc.
εἰδῇς: οἶδα — know; perf. subj. 2 sg. with pres. sense: ’you may know’
εἰπὲ: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. imper. 2 sg.
εἰρωτᾷς: εἰρωτάω (epic = ἐρωτάω) — ask, question; pres. 2 sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἰσοράασθαι: εἰσοράω — look upon, behold; pres. inf. mid., uncontracted, diectasis (= Attic εἰσορᾶσθαι)
εἰσορόωντες: εἰσοράω — look at, gaze on; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic εἰσορῶντες)
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
εὐρείης: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic εὐρείας)
εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’wide’ (κλέος εὐρύ ’wide fame’)
ζείδωρος: ζείδωρος — grain-giving (of ploughland); fem. nom. sg.; meaning disputed: usually ’giving ζειά (a kind of grain)’, an ancient alternative reads ’life-giving’ (from ζάω)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before rough breathing, cf. ἔφαθ’) — and; connective particle
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’as a god’ · also plain nom. sg. subject, an unspecified deity left unnamed: ’a god’ (θεὸς δ’ ἐκέδασσεν Ἀχαιούς ’a god scattered the Achaeans’) · also of a goddess (θεός is common gender)
θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θυράων: θύρα — door; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θυρῶν)
θυρεὸν: θυρεός — door-stone, large stone set against a doorway; masc. acc. sg.
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: κακὰ ἔργα ’bad deeds’
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’)
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … ἐποτρύνῃ ’until … urges on’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’
κεῖτ: κεῖμαι — lie; impf. 3 sg., elided (κεῖτο → κεῖτ’ before a vowel): ’lay, was lying’
κηλέῳ: κήλεος — burning, blazing; adj., neut. dat. sg., epithet of fire: ’blazing’
κικλήσκουσι: κικλήσκω (= καλέω) — call, name; pres. 3 pl., ν lost before enclitic: ’they call (it)’
κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κρέ: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρέ’ = κρέα)
κρέα: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., uncontracted (= Attic κρέα contr.)
κυκλώπεσσι: Κύκλωψ — a Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
κύκλωπος: Κύκλωψ — a Cyclops, one of a race of one-eyed giants; Polyphemus, son of Poseidon, is the one Odysseus blinded; gen. sg.
λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, take hold of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’ (γούνων λαβών ’clasping the knees’, gen. of the part grasped)
λαῖτμα: λαῖτμα — the gulf, the deep (of the sea); neut. nom./acc. sg.
λεῖπε: λείπω — leave, leave behind; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλειπε)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέλανος: μέλας — black, dark; masc./neut. gen. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
μήλων: μῆλον — sheep, small cattle; neut. gen. pl.
μεγάλ: μέγας — great, loud; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (μεγάλ’ = μεγάλα): ’loudly’
μεγάλην: μέγας — great, mighty; fem. acc. sg.
μεγαλήτορα: μεγαλήτωρ — great-spirited, great-hearted; masc. acc. sg. (of Odysseus)
μειλιχίοισι: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’
μηκάδας: μηκάς — bleating; fem. acc. pl., of goats
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’ · also neut. acc. pl. (same form), direct object: ἦγον ... μῆλα ’they led sheep’
νηλέι: νηλής — pitiless, ruthless; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νηλεῖ)
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νηῦς: ναῦς — ship; nom. sg., epic νηῦς
ξεινήιον: ξεινήιον — guest-gift; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ξένιον)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἴκαδε: οἶκος — house, home; + directional suffix -δε: ’homeward, to one’s home’
οἴνοιο: οἶνος — wine; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ (μετὰ οἷς ἑτάροισι ’among his own companions’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; masc./neut. dat. pl. (οἷς ἔπι ’on which’, of the stones)
οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg. correlative with τοῖος (τοῖος ἐὼν οἷόν μιν ’just such as when’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc./nom. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’ · also neut. nom. sg. as subject: ’nothing’ (οὐδὲν γλύκιον … γίγνεται ’nothing is sweeter’)
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὔνομα: ὄνομα — name; neut. acc. sg., epic οὔνομα (= Attic ὄνομα)
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πέτρῃσι: πέτρη — rock; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic πέτραις)
πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα: ’fat’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’rich’
παραστὰς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing beside’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
πολέων: πολύς — much, many; masc. gen. pl., uncontracted epic πολέων (= Attic πολλῶν): ’of many’
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom. pl. (agreeing with ἔγχεα): ’many’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of a verb: ’many things’ (παλαιά τε πολλά τε εἰδώς ’knowing many old things’)
πολλή: πολύς — much, many; adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’much, in plenty’
πολλῇ: πολύς — much, many; fem. dat. sg.: ’great’
πονησάμενος: πονέομαι — labour, toil at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg.: ’having laboured, having got through (his tasks)’
ποσειδάων: Ποσειδῶν — Poseidon, god of the sea, enemy of Odysseus after the blinding of his son Polyphemus; nom. sg., epic uncontracted · also elided acc. sg., Ποσειδάων’ = Ποσειδάωνα: ’Poseidon’ as object
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’ · also + dat., ’on, upon’: ποτὶ χθονί ’on the ground’
ποτὸν: ποτόν — drink, that which is drunk; neut. acc. sg.
προσηύδων: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 1 sg. (καί μιν ... προσηύδων ’I addressed him’)
πρόσθεν: πρόσθεν — before, in front, formerly; adv. (τὸ πρόσθεν ’in time past, formerly’) · also prep. + gen., ’in front of, before’
πρόφρων: πρόφρων — willing, eager-minded, well-disposed; masc. nom. sg.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’)
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόντου: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. gen. sg.
πόρον: πόρον — defective aorist (no present in use), suppletive of δίδωμι: ’gave, granted, provided’; 1 sg. or 3 pl. act.; here 1 sg.
πύματον: πύματος — last, final; neut./masc. acc. sg.
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
σπείους: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. gen. sg., epic σπείους (= Attic σπέους)
σπεῦσε: σπεύδω — hasten, press on with (a task); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔσπευσε)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’)
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. sg. · also the enclitic indefinite τις accented before a following enclitic, not interrogative: ’someone, anyone’ (ἤν τίς τοι εἴπῃσι ’if someone tells you’)
ταμὼν: τέμνω — cut; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having cut, cutting’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεὸν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; masc./neut. acc. sg.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖσδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’these’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τόδ: ὅδε — this, this here; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε)
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
τῆ: τῆ — here, take (this); old imperatival interjection used in handing something over
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φάτ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (φάτ’ = φάτο)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’ · also ’carried, were carrying’ (φέρον ἐσθῆτα ’they carried the clothes’) · also impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερον): ’I carried, I was carrying’
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φορτίδος: φορτίς — cargo-ship, freighter (φόρτος ’cargo’); fem. gen. sg.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρένες: φρήν — mind, heart, midriff (seat of feeling); fem. nom. pl.
χαμάδις: χαμάδις — to the ground, groundward; adv.
ἀέξει: ἀέξω — make grow, increase (Attic αὐξάνω); pres. 3 sg.
ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀμβροσίης: ἀμβροσία — ambrosia, the gods’ food; fem. gen. sg. (partitive, with πλήσασα): ’filled with ambrosia’
ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
ἀνέκαιε: ἀνακαίω — kindle, light up; impf. 3 sg., augmented after the preverb
ἀναΐξας: ἀναΐσσω — start up suddenly, spring up; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; gen. pl.
ἀρίστη: ἄριστος — best; superl., fem. nom. sg.
ἀτάρ: ἀτάρ — but, yet, and; conj., poetic (= αὐτάρ)
ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. acc. pl.: ’what things’ (ἃ μενοινᾷς ’what you desire’) · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: neut. acc. pl. ’his own’ (τὰ ἃ ἔργα ’his own tasks’)
ἄκρητον: ἄκρητος — unmixed, undiluted (of wine); neut. acc. sg.
ἄκρον: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; adj., neut. acc. sg. used substantively: ‘the headland’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential)
ἄντροιο: ἄντρον — cave; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἄνωγον: ἄνωγα — bid, command (perf. with pres. sense); past (impf. or plpf.) 3 pl. or 1 sg., unaugmented (augmented ἤνωγον): ’they bade, I bade’
ἄρουρα: ἄρουρα — ploughland, soil; fem. nom. sg.
ἐγώ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. (accented ἐγώ before the enclitic τοι that follows)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευσεν: κελεύω — command, order, bid; aor. 3 sg.
ἐμείναμεν: μένω — stay, wait, wait for; aor. 1 pl.
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); nom. sg.
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπέθηκε: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, set upon; aor. 3 sg. (κ-aorist)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐριστάφυλον: ἐριστάφυλος — rich in grapes (ἐρι- intensive + σταφυλή ’grape-cluster’); masc. acc. sg.
ἐρυσσάμενος: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., of launching a ship: ’having drawn down, having launched’
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἑζόμενος: ἕζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting up’
ἑκάστῃ: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. dat. sg.
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἑσπέριος: ἑσπέριος — of evening, at evening; masc. nom. sg. used adverbially: ’in the evening’
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
ἔκτοθεν: ἔκτοθεν — outside, away from (+ gen.); adv./prep.
ἔλαχον: λαγχάνω — obtain by lot, get as one’s share; aor. 1 sg. or 3 pl., + gen. of the share
ἔμβρυον: ἔμβρυον — young one, lamb or kid still at the udder; neut. acc. sg.
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔργ: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl., elided (ἔργ’ = ἔργα)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔχε: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἶχε)
ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl.: ’they hold’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕτερος: ἕτερος — the one, the other (of two); masc. nom. sg. (ὁ ἕτερος … ὁ δέ ’the one … the other’)
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἠῶ: ἠώς (Attic ἕως) — dawn; acc. sg., accusative of extent: ’on into the dawn’ · also acc. after πρός: ’towards the dawn, the east’ (πρὸς ἠῶ) · also direct object of a verb of waiting: ’(waited for) Dawn’ (ἐμείναμεν Ἠῶ δῖαν)
ἡδὺ: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’sweetly’
ἡμετέρη: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; fem. nom. sg.
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’
ἤθελον: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they wished’
ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’
ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came’
ἤμελγε: ἀμέλγω — milk; impf. 3 sg., augmented ἤ- (no ν-movable)
ἤμελγεν: ἀμέλγω — milk; impf. 3 sg., augmented ἤ- (with ν-movable)
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., fem. nom. sg.
ἦλθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’came’
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἧκεν: ἵημι — send, let go, put; aor. 3 sg. (ἧκα, with ν-movable; Attic ἧκε): ’sent, put’
ἰών: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἵκοιτο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, arrive at, reach; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., wish/potential: ’might come, may he reach’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ὀξὺ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; neut. acc. sg.
ὀρεσίτροφος: ὀρεσίτροφος — mountain-nurtured, mountain-bred; masc. nom. sg.
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁρόωντες: ὁράω — see, look at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶντες)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
ὄις: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄμβρος: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. nom. sg.
ὄρος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. acc. sg., object of ἷξε: ‘the mountain’ · also neut. nom. sg., ’a mountain’, subject of a verbless clause naming it: ἐν δ’ ὄρος αὐτῇ ’and on it a mountain’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.; neut. often adverbial: ’as much as’
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’ · also in an indirect exclamation, ’how greatly’ (ὅσσον ἄρισται ’how excellent they are’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; prep. + dat./acc.; also used as an adverb, ’beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis (ὑπὸ … ἐδήσατο = ὑπεδήσατο ’bound beneath’) · also adverbial, of breeding: ’begotten under, born of’ (ὑπὸ δ’ ἡμίονοι ’and under them [the mares], mules’) · also + dat., marking the agent with a passive verb: ’by’ (ὑπὸ μνηστῆρσιν δαμείη ’be overcome by the suitors’) · also + gen., ’from under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο) · also + gen., marking agent with a passive verb/participle beyond dying, ’by’: μεγάλου ὑπὸ κύματος ἀρθείς ’lifted up by a great wave’ · also + gen., of cause: ὑπὸ ῥιπῆς ’at the rush (of the throw)’
ὑψηλάων: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ὡπλίσσατο: ὁπλίζω — make ready, prepare, equip; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic double σ (ὡπλίσσατο): ’made ready for himself’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’)
ᾔτεε: αἰτέω — ask, ask for, request; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc. dat. sg.: ’his own (son)’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which; masc. dat. sg. (δοίη δ’ ᾧ κ’ ἐθέλοι ’give her to whom he wished’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν, neut. dat. sg. (same form), agreeing with a neut. noun: πεδίοιο ... ᾧ ἔνι ... ’a plain in which is...’
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηιδίως: ῥᾳδίως — easily; adv., epic ῥηιδίως (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
